mstari._note: Our own server. Five tools: parse_intake_record (read), score_priority (writes draft triage cards), rank_queue (writes the queue board), confirm_priority (GATED: publishes a priority to the live queue - named clinician required), raise_recheck_flag (GATED: deterioration second-look flag - named clinician required).

fetch._justification: Borrowed, not ours: the official reference fetch server pulls the live SATS/Kenya Triage Scale reference pages and any facility-directory updates at plan time - writing and maintaining our own web crawler would be fragile duplicated work for zero clinical value.
